glosses: season (one of the four parts of the year in temperate regions: winter, spring, summer and autumn)
season (a certain time of the year, when something in particular happens)
season (the time of the year when teams compete)

examples.text: Il y a quatre saisons dans une année.
examples.en: There are four seasons in a year.

examples.text: Il fait chaud pour la saison.
examples.en: It's warm for this time of year.
Which season do you like best?
